title: feat(nfmax): sign(n_mu*) unique letter: reverse and face none
science: Selector sign(n_{mu*}) with mu* the SMALLEST-index maximiser of |n_mu|: all four letters `-`, reverse=face=`none`. The runner's own mutation `mutation-largest-index-changes-letter-A` proves the tie-break is load-bearing - |n_1(A)|=|n_2(A)| and n_2(A)=+1/3, so a largest-index tie-break flips L(A) to + and reverse from `none` to `all`. The verdict pair is not invariant under an arbitrary indexing convention.
